attributes.board_name: Connecticut Board of Veterinary Medicine (Department of Public Health)

rules.alternatives: Voluntary national credentialing (VTNE/AAVSB) and association membership are outside state law; any CE follows that organization's rules.
rules.notes: Connecticut does not license or register veterinary technicians; no state CE applies. The veterinary practice act (Conn. Gen. Stat. ch. 384, §§ 20-196 to 20-206) licenses veterinarians only and contains no technician credential; DPH's veterinary licensing pages list veterinarian licensure only.
